question: Sabarimala Sri Ayyappa temple is situated in the state of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sabarimala Sri Ayyappa temple** is one of the most prominent and ancient temples in India.
 
• It is located in the **Pathanamthitta district** of **Kerala**.
 
• The temple is dedicated to **Lord Ayyappa**, and it attracts millions of devotees every year, especially during the Mandala season (November to January).
 
• It is situated on a hilltop at an altitude of about 1260 meters above sea level, surrounded by dense forests and mountains.
 
• The temple is known for its strict pilgrimage rituals and practices, including the 41-day vratham (penance) that devotees must observe before visiting.
 
• Women of menstruating age (10-50 years) were traditionally not allowed to enter the temple, a practice that has been subject to legal and social debates in recent years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kerala is known for its rich cultural heritage and is often referred to as "God's Own Country".
 
• The state is famous for its backwaters, ayurvedic treatments, and vibrant festivals.
 
• Kerala has the highest literacy rate in India and is known for its progressive social indicators.
 
• It is bordered by Karnataka to the north, Tamil Nadu to the east and south, and the Arabian Sea to the west.
